product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Abigail Leather Sofa, 86"W, Dark Brown
product.description: Comfort meets class in this attractive transitional-style sofa. The angular shape makes a statement in your home decor, and four dark-colored legs add elegance to the piece. The back and seat cushions are reversible to prolong the life of this sofa. 86"W x 41"D x 35"H; seat height: 20"H; seat depth: 40"D; seat back height: 15"H; arm height: 25"H; leg height: 1.5"H Sturdy wood frame with rich 100% top grain leather The removable seat and back cushions ensure durability and comfort. Classy angular design pairs well with contemporary-style home decor. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Vacuum or wipe with a dry cloth. Spot clean if needed. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
